info.title: Foxtrot blocks
instructions: Low block (T-44 / T-54 primary) 4,000–5,999 ft MSL
Transition altitudes by direction: High 12,700 ft north/east, 12,200 ft south/west; Low 6,700 ft north/east, 6,200 ft south/west
Claim your block on Foxtrot Common, CH 22
info.source: Binder, p. 26; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 94.

info.title: Foxtrot warnings
instructions: Traffic operating in or departing from Foxtrot shall avoid North Mustang (6,500–17,500 ft MSL) at all times
Minimum altitude over the Aransas Wildlife Refuge is 3,000 ft AGL
Houston Center will not provide flight following without an explicit request (VHF CH 22 or CH 23)
info.source: Binder, p. 27; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 93.
